evidence.evidence_text: Given the significant resource allocation required by training and evaluating models, it is advantageous to have an efficient method for selecting high-quality IT data.

However, existing methods for instruction data selection have limitations such as relying on fragile external APIs, being affected by biases in GPT models, or reducing the diversity of the selected instruction dataset.
In this paper, we propose an industrial-friendly, expert-aligned and diversity-preserved instruction data selection method: Clustering and Ranking (CaR).
